data.title: Bojná in winter – photographs of the snow-covered hillfort
data.excerpt: Winter has slowly got under way and our collaborator Naj has sent us these 2 pictures of Bojná in winter. I hope they have pleased you as much as they pleased me.
data.metaTitle: Bojná in winter – the snow-covered hillfort
data.metaDescription: Two photographs of a snow-covered Bojná, sent in by our collaborator Naj — winter pictures of the hillfort that we hope will please you as well.
